blocks.text: PROFILE

Data Scientist and Staff AI Engineer with experience across software engineering, data infrastructure, and ML systems. Build anomaly detection, time-series, and LLM applications from problem definition and experimentation through deployment and evaluation. Combine statistical analysis with hands-on engineering and technical leadership.

SARAD
Applied Machine Learning Research · github.com/taimax13/SARAD
Co-developed anomaly detection for synthetic aperture radar imagery, combining RX statistics, autoencoder reconstruction, and anomaly-score fusion.
Evaluated model behavior using labeled imagery, precision–recall analysis, and failure analysis to distinguish anomalies from normal scene variation.

Creator and AI Data Scientist | August 2024–Present · github.com/taimax13/chagu-prototype
Created Chagu, a research project on agentic AI security and accountability based on provenance graphs.

Developed graph-based attribution and reproducible evaluation tooling to trace agent actions and analyze failures under missing, conflicting, and forged evidence. Designed controlled experiments with baseline comparisons and ablations to assess attribution quality and uncertainty.

Applied ML and agent evaluation
Built evaluation and benchmarking workflows for autonomous security agents using Opengrep scans and curated ground truth to assess finding quality, coverage, and run cost.
Developed telemetry pipelines and BigQuery reporting for repeatable model comparisons, regression analysis, and investigation of data-quality issues.

LLMs and agents: Vertex AI, Bedrock, LiteLLM, Langfuse, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Temporal, model evaluation, and tool integration.
